description: This Java source file defines the 'EventSendNotAllowedException' class, which represents an exception thrown when an attempt is made to send an event for a Thing that either does not exist or lacks necessary permissions. It includes constructors, builder pattern implementation, and methods for JSON deserialization, making it a key exception class related to specific error handling in the 'things' command signals of the Eclipse Ditto project.
